_how_to_use: Copy the inner object into library/inverters.json under a lower-case key like 'brand-model'. Add one entry per size in a series. phase is 1 or 3. max_ac_current_a is the datasheet maximum output current. Set verified=true only if every value was read from the manufacturer datasheet, and cite it in remarks.

brand-model.remarks: Source: <datasheet file name / URL, edition, date>
